_instructions.overview: Copy this file, rename it (e.g. my-song.json), fill in the fields, then drag it onto FretFlow to load it.
_instructions.id: Unique short key, no spaces (e.g. 'my-song'). Must be unique across all songs.
_instructions.title: Full song title as it should appear in the app.
_instructions.key: Musical key (e.g. G, Am, D, E). Informational only.
_instructions.bpm: Beats per minute at full speed (integer). Try to match the original recording.
chords: Array of chord changes. Each entry:
beat   — beat number from start (0 = very first beat, 8 = start of measure 2 in 4/4)
lyrics: Array of lyric lines. Each entry:
beat   — beat number when this line starts singing
text   — the words for that phrase
notes: Array of individual notes/chord strums on the fretboard. Each entry:
b      — beat position (float, e.g. 2.5 = halfway through beat 3)
dur    — duration in beats (e.g. 1 = one beat, 0.5 = eighth note)
type   — 'chord' for strum patterns, 'note' for individual picked notes
chord  — chord name this note belongs to (for 'chord' type, matches chord bar)
finger — optional: which fretting finger to use (1=index, 2=middle, 3=ring, 4=pinky)

beat_guide.4/4 time: 8 beats per measure. Measure 1 = beats 0-7, Measure 2 = beats 8-15, etc.
beat_guide.typical chord bar: One chord per measure = chord change every 8 beats.
beat_guide.strum timing: 4 strums per measure at beats 0, 2, 4, 6. 8 strums at 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7.
